The document consistently distinguishes array size from observed caller domain.

The canonical loop confirms the seven IDs, signed sentinel, mapping-failure skip, missing-JObj branch, strict threshold and post-loop call order. Independently restored lb_800115F4 source confirms global-list scale/count evolution and recycling, rather than a collision refresh. The document preserves numeric-state ambiguity and shared rather than per-GObj lifetime.

Canonical initialization writes the static parameter cache. The lookup guards both sentinels, discards the kind result, and returns the same cached field for joints 0 and 1 without a pointer guard. The complete module contains no descriptor copy/free or cache reset. The stated external lifetime requirement is a precondition, not an asserted ownership transfer.
